TOR.text: Jamal Shead led the way for the Raptors on Monday finishing with a team-high 20 points and a game-high 11 assists for his second consecutive double-double this season, which is a first-ever feat in his career, and the first Raptor to do so this season.
Shead's 27 assists over his last two games is the most by any player in the NBA in a two-game span this season.

PHI.text: Anfernee Simons is the first 76er in franchise history to make at least five three-pointers off the bench in three consecutive games (10/28 vs. IND (6-10 3FG), 10/30 vs. NYK (5-8 3FG), 10/31 vs. CHA (5-9 3FG)).

WAS.text: Logged his 39th career 40-point double-double on 11/9 at Detroit, tying Michael Jordan for the seventh-most since 1973-74.

DAL.text: P.J. Washington Jr. surpassed 6,000 career points (6,009) and 2,000 points as a Maverick (2,010), moving into 47th place on Dallas' all-time scoring list (vs. SAC, 11/2/26).
Kyrie Irving recorded 24 points at IND (10/23/26) to surpass Mavericks legend Mark Aguirre (18,458) for 74th place in the NBA's all-time scoring list.
Zaccharie Risacher notched 5 steals in his Mavericks debut, setting a career high and tied Shawn Bradley for the second-most steals in a season opener in Mavs history (6, Brad Davis).
Cooper Flagg needs 21 assists (379) to reach 400 career assists.
Naji Marshall needs 76 field goals (1,424) to reach 1,500 career field goals made.

MIN.text: Minnesota outscored their first three opponents opponents by 70 points this season, the 10th highest through three games in NBA history.

Minnesota has now made 148 three-pointers on the season, marking the second-most made threes in the NBA this season (Atlanta: 155) and the tied for the second-most made threes through the first nine games of a season in franchise history.

The Wolves held an eight-point lead over the Raptors at halftime on Oct. 25, marking the fifth time Minnesota had led by 8+ points at halftime in each of their first three games of the season and the first time doing so since the 2022-23 season.
The Wolves’ 23-point win against the Raptors on Oct. 25 marked the second-highest margin of victory in a home opener in franchise history (+36, 2016 vs. Memphis).

CHA.text: Miller passed Nic Batum for ninth place on the franchise's all-time leaderboard for 3-pointers made (497) versus Miami (Oct. 24).
Brandon Miller logged his third-straight 30-point game at Detroit (Oct. 28), becoming the first player in the NBA this season to post three-straight 30-point performances.
Brandon Miller became the second-fastest player in NBA history to reach 500 career 3-pointers made (Oct. 26 vs. WAS).
PJ Hall is 2 rebounds away from 100 career rebounds.
Kon Knueppel is 68 rebounds away from 500 career rebounds.
